gloss: to commute to school; to attend school

definitions.gloss: to commute to school; to attend school regularly
definitions.explanation: To travel to school on a regular basis. Refers to the daily journey between home and school, not the act of studying there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通学|つうがく}する。
examples.english: To commute to school by train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{通学|つうがく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many students commute to school by bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{片道|かたみち}→片道：00199_katamichi⟧１⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{通学|つうがく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I spend one hour each way commuting from home to school.

notes:
Specifically refers to the regular commute between home and school. The noun form ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧ is commonly used in compound words related to school commuting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧{路|ろ}: school route
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: commuting time (to school)
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧: student commuter pass
- ⟦{徒歩|とほ}→徒歩：03031_toho⟧⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧: walking to school
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧⟦{圏内|けんない}→圏内：16392_kennai⟧: within commuting distance of a school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to commute to work — same structure but for employment rather than school
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}する→登校する：18777_toukou⟧: to go to school — refers to a single trip to school on a given day, not the habitual commute

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used in both everyday conversation and formal contexts such as school regulations.
